name: Lorwyn
description: Lorwyn is an idyllic plane of perpetual midsummer where races of fable live together, and every three centuries it transforms into its mirror-image, Shadowmoor.

description_citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Lorwyn is an idyllic plane of perpetual midsummer where races of fable live together, and every three centuries it transforms into its mirror-image, Shadowmoor.

citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Its cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor every three centuries.

citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Eirdu is the living embodiment of Lorwyn.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: In the most recent transformation, pockets of Lorwyn sprout across Shadowmoor, splitting villages and throwing the plane into turmoil.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

status.text: The latest event shows pockets of Lorwyn sprouting across Shadowmoor and throwing the plane into turmoil.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Holding Sygg's Crescent, Brigid meets the Source of the Wanderwine and survives the shift into Shadowmoor intact.
timeline.quote: which enabled her to survive the change between Lorwyn to Shadowmoor with her memories, abilities, and physical image intact.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid knocks Sygg out to save Jack's life.
timeline.quote: When Sygg wanted to kill Jack, Brigid knocked him out to save Jack's life.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid gives Jack her magical wingbow.
timeline.quote: She gave Jack her magical wingbow, capable of flight.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen takes over the role of Queen of the Fae and restores the day/night cycle.
timeline.quote: Maralen had taken over the role of the Queen of Fae and restored the normal day/night cycle.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4520 AR Gryffid, second-in-command of Rhys's Hemlock pack, warns him against nonstandard tactics in a raid on boggarts; Rhys is stripped of rank and Gryffid becomes pack leader.
timeline.quote: Gryffid was elevated to leader of their pack.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath; Gryffid finds the corpse, arranges a funeral pyre and swears vengeance on Rhys.
timeline.quote: ending with Nath's death at the hands of the outlaw traitor.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid comes to respect his new commander Eidren and hunts Rhys until the Great Aurora; when he catches Rhys, Eidren offers Rhys a return to the Gilt-Leaf.
timeline.quote: When he finally caught Rhys, Eidren dismissed Gryffid and made Rhys an offer to return to the Gilt-Leaf

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Harrick Teeg breaks a curse on two kithkin brothers with enchanted ribbons, founding the Lammastide tradition.
timeline.quote: the cleric Harrick Teeg broke the spell.

citation.text: "Kithkin", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigric, Morecote and Erewaker die on the journey to the dawnglove clearing, harried by the Deffroad clique's attempt to resurrect Oona.
timeline.quote: though all three died along the journey

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Ferrafor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona creates Oko as a vessel for her memories, but he turns against her and flees.
timeline.quote: a shapeshifter named Oko who turned his inherited intellect against her

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona creates Maralen and instills her with a piece of her own soul.
timeline.quote: and instilled the imposter with a piece of her own soul

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen gains sentience and joins others to investigate Oona.
timeline.quote: banded together with others from across Lorwyn to investigate Oona and the effect she was having on the plane

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Merrow of Lorwyn change after the Aurora, becoming more fishlike.
timeline.quote: After the Aurora, merrows became more fishlike

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Merrows". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys, Maralen and her faeries find Rosheen asleep, surrounded by dancing changelings.
timeline.quote: eventually came upon Rosheen, who was in a deep sleep

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen's plan pulls them into Rosheen's sleep, producing a shared dreamscape.
timeline.quote: Maralen devised a plan to pull them all into Rosheen’s sleep

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dream map shows the plane sliding into darkness; Rhys ends the dream and Brion is killed by Gilt-Leaf forces.
timeline.quote: Shortly after, Brion was killed by Gilt-Leaf forces.

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid takes the Crescent of Morningtide as the Great Aurora sweeps the world.
timeline.quote: unfortunately, Brigid took it as the Great Aurora swept across the world.

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the past the treefolk of Lorwyn waged war with the kithkin and ruled much of the plane as dictators.
timeline.quote: the plane's treefolk waged war with the kithkin and ruled significant portions of the plane as dictators.

citation.text: "Treefolk", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yew treefolk dwindle until only Colfenor remains, whose offspring The Sapling is destroyed by Oona.
timeline.quote: until only one remained: Colfenor , the Last Yew; who only produced The Sapling , which was destroyed by Oona .

citation.text: "Treefolk", section "Yew Treefolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Endry awakens and the three unite into the clique, leaving Oona's haven to explore Lorwyn.
timeline.quote: the clique left Oona's haven to face and enjoy Lorwyn together

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The triplets meet Ashling on a ferry and save the passengers from an arbomander.
timeline.quote: They saved her and the other passengers when the ferry was attacked by an arbomander

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Assignment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The clique secretly spies on Rhys, Brigid and Maralen and reports to Oona.
timeline.quote: the trio was, in actuality, secretly spying on them and reporting their movements to Oona

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Assignment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Odum and Broadbark fight the giant Moran the Destroyer for a hundred dawns until he falls into namesleep and awakens as Moran the Gardener.
timeline.quote: Their battle lasted a hundred dawns, until Moran became so exhausted that he fell into namesleep.

citation.text: Indomitable Ancients (Morningtide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Maralen sends the Vendilion clique on the gravest of tasks.
timeline.quote: Maralen sent Veesa, Endry, and Iliona—the Vendilion clique—on the gravest of tasks.

citation.text: Maralen of the Mornsong (Morningtide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rhys, blamed for a cataclysmic event that killed many elves and with his horns broken, is hunted by his society.
timeline.quote: He's being blamed for a cataclysmic event that killed many of his fellows.

citation.text: "Morningtide", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elves pull out all the stops to bring Rhys to their vicious brand of justice.
timeline.quote: they are pulling out all the stops to bring him to their vicious brand of justice.

citation.text: "Morningtide", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The clique lulls the party to sleep to read their thoughts but cannot breach Maralen's mind.
timeline.quote: He found her mind impregnably guarded and her secrets unreachable

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Endry is sent to save Brigid and then guide the sapling while his sisters serve Maralen.
timeline.quote: Endry was dispatched to save Brigid Baeli from Gilt-Leaf hunters

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Endry's mushroom ring lets Maralen divert energy from Ashling's ritual.
timeline.quote: Endry's mushroom faerie ring planted at the sapling's body allowed Maralen to divert a part of the energy from Ashling's ritual for herself.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor takes Rhys as apprentice and teaches him yew magic.
timeline.quote: Colfenor apprenticed a young Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sapling plays a role in the Great Aurora and the war between Oona and Maralen but does not survive; a cutting is saved and revived as Ferrafor.
timeline.quote: The sapling would not survive the ensuing conflict

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Age of Oona, the elves tighten their grip and cull eyeblights.
timeline.quote: Eyeblights were heavily culled, with some boggart communities dwindling to extinction

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Pendulum Year". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora changes Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, turning a constantly sunny world into one of perpetual night.
timeline.quote: But thanks to the Great Aurora , everything's changed.

citation.text: "Shadowmoor", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona lures Veesa back into her service, shattering the clique.
timeline.quote: Later, Oona managed to lure Veesa back into her service, shattering the clique completely.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor; features correspond but are changed, such as Kinsbaile becoming Kinscaer.
timeline.quote: Kinsbaile became Kinscaer.

citation.text: "The Savory Mailbag". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The events of the Time Spiral block change the planeswalker spark, making planeswalkers mortal.
timeline.quote: The events of the Time Spiral block changed the nature of the planeswalker spark

citation.text: "The Savory Mailbag". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eventide team asks Creative which legends should appear, and the Sapling of Colfenor is concepted from the Lorwyn and Morningtide novels.
timeline.quote: The card Sapling of Colfenor arose from the Lorwyn and Morningtide novels, in which a strange new treefolk sapling grew from the seedcone of Rhys's old mentor, Colfenor.

citation.text: "Flavor Driven". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: On Lorwyn the Great Aurora changes the plane to Shadowmoor as Nissa confronts the elves who were killing boggarts.
timeline.quote: Just as she confronted the elves about this, the Great Aurora arrived and changed all of Lorwyn to Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The author explains that flamekin are magical by nature.
timeline.quote: Lorwyn's flamekin, a race of sentient fire elementals, are also magical by nature

citation.text: "Continuum". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Nov 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nissa lands on Lorwyn and sees the coming blight in a vision.
timeline.quote: Lorwyn, it called itself.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa is found by the elves of the blight hunt led by Dwynen and joins the hunt.
timeline.quote: Take up your blade and prove yourself.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Galed kills boggarts despite Nissa's pleas, and Nissa feels one die.
timeline.quote: And then she felt it die.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa turns her blade on Galed and Dwynen turns on her, just as Shadowmoor arrives.
timeline.quote: How dare you come to my forest and tell me what I can do?

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora of Shadowmoor sweeps over Lorwyn and transforms Dwynen as she is about to shoot Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dwynen was paralyzed, caught in the Great Aurora of Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa resists a voice tempting her to stay and, chanting Zendikar, steps through the void and follows a thread home.
timeline.quote: It pulled her with great force through the tear in the fabric of Lorwyn and out into the void.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Sunrise Brake brings down legions of machines in their wrath.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , they brought down legions of the machines in their wrath.

citation.text: "Treefolk", section "Rowan Treefolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, kithkin use the thoughtweft as a weapon until the Phyrexians exploit it, and many kithkin cut themselves off from it.
timeline.quote: Rather than suffer, many kithkin cut themselves off from the thoughtweft entirely.

citation.text: "Kithkin", section "Nomadic Kithkin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion, kithkin cut off from the thoughtweft cannot rejoin their clachans and form nomadic bands.
timeline.quote: These kithkin chose to leave and form nomadic bands with others who had suffered this same pain.

citation.text: "Kithkin", section "Nomadic Kithkin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian invasion nearly decimates the Lorwyn elves, whose dominion becomes a network of power for the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: the Lorwyn elves that had once terrorized the denizens of Lorwyn were nearly decimated

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pockets of Lorwyn sprout across Shadowmoor, splitting villages and throwing the plane into turmoil.
timeline.quote: Across Shadowmoor, pockets of Lorwyn sprouted up in the darkness.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian invasion destroys the plane's power balance and nearly decimates the Lorwyn elves, whose networks of power are turned to Phyrexian use.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian invasion destroyed the fragile power balance of the plane

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn merrow flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine when the Phyrexians attack the water.
timeline.quote: Many were forced to flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Many flamekin disappear underground and hibernate; around half later return as rimekin.
timeline.quote: with around half of them having returned as rimekin, their hibernation causing a change in forms.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Elvish authority in Lorwyn collapses as the invasion destroys the infrastructure of the power imbalance, letting other species reclaim sovereignty.
timeline.quote: This vacuum allowed the other species on the plane to gain ground, clawing back ancestral lands and reclaiming sovereignty.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The students flee the darkness and the roaring beast; Sanar bolts first and Abigale escapes into the air.
timeline.quote: Sanar was the first to turn and bolt.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The moon-headed beast emerges from the dolmen gate and plods away, followed by darkness, and Tam staggers out in its wake.
timeline.quote: the head of the beast emerged through the dolmen gate, the moon at its crown growing brighter as soon as it was in the open air.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The four students regroup and run from the spreading night toward patches of daylight.
timeline.quote: the four students ran for the remains of the day as hard and as fast as they had ever run for anything.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: A stout archer waves the students toward her across patches of darkness and leads them into an ash forest.
timeline.quote: Follow me,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid asks the students who they are and winces when Abigale's telepathy enters her mind, since they are not part of the thoughtweft.
timeline.quote: You're not part of the thoughtweft. You're not meant to be there.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid introduces herself, explains that people tumble into Lorwyn since the metal invasion, and identifies the beast as Isilu.
timeline.quote: My name is Brigid Baeli, hero of Kinsbaile, and I'm pleased to welcome you to Lorwyn.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid says Isilu should be sleeping, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in their territories.
timeline.quote: It's supposed to be sleeping right now, not stomping through Lorwyn and seeding Shadowmoor in our territories.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The spreading darkness washes over and erases the Omenpath, and Abigale flies up to confirm it is gone.
timeline.quote: it washed over the iridescent triangle, seemingly wiping it away.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Tam asks Brigid for a place to go and Brigid agrees to take them somewhere.
timeline.quote: I think I do, yes,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid leads the students toward Goldmeadow, saying not just anyone could get them there.
timeline.quote: But not just anyone could get you to Goldmeadow

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students escape Goldmeadow and reason that the night side is frightened, not evil.
timeline.quote: I don't think the night is bad here, just different

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Three treefolk, Morecote, Erewaker and Sigric, travel across Lorwyn to plant a yew sapling for a new Rising.
timeline.quote: We have a sacred duty to the yew trees.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Three faeries taunt Morecote, calling him a failure, and challenge him to a duel.
timeline.quote: If you duel all of us at once and win, we'll tell you something.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Morecote accepts and clears a field for the duel with the faeries.
timeline.quote: Come and test my mettle, then.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Morecote crushes Meadowsweet in his grip while the other two faeries poison Sigric.
timeline.quote: Blood spills upon the white Meadowsweet and upon the bark of the ash tree.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The faeries flee, remarking that yew grows best within a corpse.
timeline.quote: Yew grows best within a corpse.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Sigric, weakened by poison, tells them they must pass a sleeping giant to reach the veil and rambles about Colfenor.
timeline.quote: It cannot grow where the sun warms its leaves.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: They spot Forget-Me-Not and Baby's Breath hovering near the giant's head, harrying her awake.
timeline.quote: All Erewaker can do is watch in horror as they harry the giant.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Morecote tears the sapling from Sigric, hands it to Erewaker and stays to face the awakened giant.
timeline.quote: Morecote tears the sapling straight from Sigric's bark.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The giant demands who woke her, seeking a new walking stick.
timeline.quote: So, which one of you will be my new walking stick?

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Sigric gives Erewaker a sheet of his bark to plant with the sapling and conjures vines to cover her escape as he and Morecote face the giant.
timeline.quote: with the last of his might he calls a wall of vines between them.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Rhain and Cerys trade rude letters, with Rhain calling Gethin a coward.
timeline.quote: Your uncle is a coward.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Rhain tells Cerys he met Gethin the day the aurora shifted, when a boggart attacked him and Gethin rescued him.
timeline.quote: I would never have made it out if Gethin hadn't been there.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Rhain, calcifying and hiding from the elves of Lys Alana, decides not to ask Cerys for dawnglove and instead asks to keep corresponding.
timeline.quote: Very soon, the mark would calcify his heart, and he would die.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Rhain writes his final letter confessing his feelings for Cerys and collapses.
timeline.quote: You, Cerys, are the very best part of my day.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys crosses the aurora and feeds Rhain dawnglove, reviving him.
timeline.quote: You fed me dawnglove. You crossed the aurora.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys's broken reliquary fails, and she turns on Rhain with cruel words as the Morningtide changes her.
timeline.quote: No wonder you were afraid of being cast out,

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Rhain carries the calcifying Cerys toward the border, but she turns to stone from the waist down as they enter the aurora.
timeline.quote: Cerys was stone from the waist down.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Years after the Phyrexian invasion, Brigid finds four stranded Arcavios students and leads them to Goldmeadow.
timeline.quote: she found four students from the plane of Arcavios , Abigale , Tamira , Kirol , and Sanar , who had been stranded by an instanced Omenpath.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys is freed from his pact with Maralen and fades away into the daylight.
timeline.quote: then watched as Rhys was freed from the magical pact he had forged with Maralen decades ago and faded away into the daylight.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
